---
title: "Understanding no_std"
---

# Understanding no_std
Embedded microcontrollers lack operating system services like virtual memory, filesystems, and threads. In embedded Rust, programs declare `#![no_std]`, compiling without the standard library while retaining the core language and primitives.

```rust
// #![no_std]
// #![no_main]
//
// use core::panic::PanicInfo;
//
// #[panic_handler]
// fn panic(_info: &PanicInfo) -> ! {
//     loop {}
// }
```
